cohort: Pregnant women with placenta increta or percreta (PIP)
finding: Preoperative abdominal aortic balloon occlusion (AABO) was associated with significant reductions in blood loss volume, red cell suspension transfusion volume, plasma transfusion volume, surgery time, and hysterectomy rates in women with placenta increta or percreta.
mod_finding: There were no differences in Apgar scores or neonatal complications between the AABO group and the control group, indicating that AABO has little adverse effect on newborns.
